'''Nor Wedd''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Tundra Dowmeia/Legends|Tundra Dowmeia]], a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] representing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|senate]]. During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Wedd, Dowmeia, and aide [[Zil Topur/Legends|Zil Topur]] were present in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when [[Junior Representative/Legends|Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] proposed [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|emergency powers]] for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Wedd clapped for Binks's motion.

==Biography==
Nor Wedd<ref name="Depth">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]<ref name="SWCTP" /> [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Tundra Dowmeia/Legends|Tundra Dowmeia]],<ref name="Depth" /> a [[Loyalist/Legends|loyalist]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented<ref name="DB-Tundra">{{DB|character|tundradowmeia|Dowmeia, Tundra}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="DB-Tundra" /> Wedd, Dowmeia, and<ref name="DB-Quarren" /> the additional aide<ref name="Depth" /> [[Zil Topur/Legends|Zil Topur]] took office<ref name="DB-Quarren" /> after Senator [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]] was censured from the role during a [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] scandal<ref name="DB-Tundra" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TikkesDate">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_5.html|Senators Implicated in Slave Ring}} is set on the date 13:4:4, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref>

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="AOTCDate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref>  Wedd, Dowmeia, and Topur were present inside<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During their [[Time/Legends|time]] there, the trio stood in a [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpod]] while [[Junior Representative/Legends|Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] put forward that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] be given [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|emergency powers]] immediately in reponse to the ongoing [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. All three Quarren clapped for the motion, which Palpatine quickly excepted. Palpatine followed by stating he would create the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as his first act.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Personality and traits==
The Quarren had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and orange skin.<ref name="SWCTP" /> "Nor" was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] Quarren name that meant "strong," while "Wedd" was a Quarren surname that meant "preparer of meals," albeit in an archaic form.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
While at the Senate Building, Wedd wore a crimson-colored [[Clothing/Legends|robe]].<ref name="SWCTP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nor Wedd was first mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for the Quarren,<ref name="DB-Quarren" /> published on [[February 27]], [[2002]].<ref name="ACU">{{SWArchive|url=databank/news/2002/02/news20020227.html|text=Aliens & Creatures Update}}</ref> The character was later first pictured, though an image from the then upcoming [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], in ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]]<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and published on [[April 23]], 2002.<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20020227.html|text=Book Preview: DK Episode II Books}}</ref> Wedd then first appeared in Episode II, which released on [[May 16]], 2002.<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> A scene where Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] urges her colleges to vote against the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] featured Wedd, standing with Dowmeia and Topur on a repulsorpod, but was ultimately not included in the final cut of the film.<ref name="Deleted">{{Film|II}} &#x2013; Deleted Scene: Padme Addresses the Senate</ref>

The name "Nor Wedd" was first used in connection to a film character in an Episode II [[Depth Commentary]] available on [[StarWars.com]], accessible through the DVD-ROM home release of ''Attack of the Clones''<ref name="Depth" /> on [[November 12]], 2002.<ref name="DVD">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/news/2002/08/news20020801.html|text=Episode II On DVD & VHS}}</ref> The text commentary did not specify which aide the name belonged to.<ref name="Depth" /> The StarWars.com [[Image Attack]] feature incorrectly identified a picture of one of the aides as Tundra Dowmeia on [[May 13]], [[2003]].<ref name="IA">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/05/imageattack20030513.html|series=Image Attack|text=Tundra's Support}}</ref>
